name: Scent Trail Renderer
description: Draws a short-lived ribbon of scent motes from the player toward the target selected by pets.scent_tracker. The trail is a bearing aid, not a navigation path: it never claims that terrain is walkable and never chooses or reveals a target. Motes are pooled and capped so leaving tracking active cannot grow the scene without bound. The renderer consumes tracker state and discovery events, clears immediately when the target is reached or the pet is unequipped, and exposes a reduced-motion mode that replaces travel animation with a static fading trail.

inputs.name: maxMotes
inputs.description: Hard cap on live trail motes. Also fixes the pool size, making the effect's worst-case draw and memory cost explicit.

inputs.name: moteSpacing
inputs.description: World-space spacing between motes along the target bearing.

inputs.name: groundOffset
inputs.description: Height above the sampled ground for each mote. Presentation samples terrain but does not modify collision or movement.

inputs.name: moteLifetimeSeconds
inputs.description: Fade lifetime per mote. Short lifetimes keep the hint near the player instead of painting a permanent line across the world.

inputs.name: reducedMotion
inputs.description: When true, disable travelling pulses and show a static fading trail with the same target information.

outputs.name: visible
outputs.description: Whether a valid trail is currently rendered.

outputs.name: activeMotes
outputs.description: Live mote count, always less than or equal to maxMotes.

outputs.name: targetBearing
outputs.description: Last tracker bearing used for rendering, exposed for accessibility indicators.

outputs.name: targetDistance
outputs.description: Last tracker distance used for rendering, exposed for non-visual equivalents.
